quizName: DMV Practice Test #4 20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: When carrying a passenger on a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Have a seat big enough for two people.
Have only one set of footrests.
Tell the passenger not to wear protective clothing.
Put a sticker on the brake light to warn other drivers about the passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have a seat big enough for two people.
questions.explanation: Do not carry a passenger unless your motorcycle has a seat big enough for two people. The motorcycle must have footrests for the passenger. Your passenger should wear the same protective gear you wear.

questions.question: Alcohol impairs your riding ability:
questions.explanation: Even one drink can hurt your ability to ride safely. You can be impaired well below the legal alcohol limit. No amount of alcohol is safe before riding.

questions.question: The only way to remove alcohol from your body is:
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to eliminate alcohol. There is no quick way to sober up.

questions.question: You should do a complete check of your motorcycle:
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need more frequent checks than cars. Check your motorcycle completely before every ride.

questions.question: Which surface provides good traction for your tires?
questions.explanation: Several surfaces have poor traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings are more dangerous for motorcycles than dry pavement.

questions.question: What helps other drivers see you at an intersection?

options.text: Swerve within your lane to get attention.

questions.explanation: Use your headlight and ride in a position that makes you visible to oncoming traffic. Keep space around your motorcycle so you can move quickly if needed.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: For maximum protection, wear a helmet certified by the:
questions.explanation: Use a motorcycle helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards for best protection.

questions.question: If a friend has drunk too much and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Tell them to take quiet roads.

questions.explanation: Never let someone ride if they have drunk too much. Do what you can to stop them, including taking their keys. Help them find another way to get home.

questions.question: When checking tires before a ride, you should look at all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Before each ride, check your tire air pressure, tread, and general wear.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride to prevent problems. Small issues on a motorcycle are more dangerous than on a car.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, what should motorcycle riders watch out for?

options.text: Motorists looking for a place to park.

questions.explanation: Be careful when passing parked vehicles. A car may pull out into your path.

questions.question: What material should you look for in a protective jacket or pants?
questions.explanation: Wear long pants and a jacket to cover your arms and legs. Leather provides the best protection.

questions.question: Which vehicles must have an annual inspection?

options.text: Only cars and motorcycles with a passenger seat.
All motor vehicles, including motorcycles and mopeds.

questions.correctAnswerText: All motor vehicles, including motorcycles and mopeds.
questions.explanation: All registered motor vehicles in Texas must have an annual inspection. This includes motorcycles and mopeds.

questions.question: What should you do when riding with a passenger?

options.text: Assume they have ridden a motorcycle before.
Do not assume they have ridden a motorcycle before. Explain what to do.
Do not let them ask questions.
Do not explain anything because they are just a passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not assume they have ridden a motorcycle before. Explain what to do.
questions.explanation: Your passenger needs to know how to stay safe. Never assume they know what to do. Give clear instructions before every ride.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, what must you do?

options.text: You may ride on the shoulder.
You may pass in a no passing zone.
You must start and finish the pass in a legal passing zone.
You should honk to make the other driver slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must start and finish the pass in a legal passing zone.
questions.explanation: All passes must happen in legal passing zones and within the speed limit.

questions.question: How do you control the accelerator on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is on the right handgrip. You control it with your right hand.

questions.question: What is the correct way to pass a vehicle?

options.text: You may speed up past the speed limit.
You may ignore no passing zone markings if you started in a passing zone.
You may pass on the shoulder.
You must stay within the speed limit and pass only in legal passing zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stay within the speed limit and pass only in legal passing zones.
questions.explanation: Always pass within the speed limit and only where it is safe and legal.

questions.question: What should you do before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle?

options.text: Ride it like your own bike since all bikes are the same.
Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
Trust the owner that everything works.
Assume you know where all the controls are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Check the controls and learn the gear pattern before riding. Test the throttle, clutch, and brakes first.

questions.question: How can you increase your visibility on a motorcycle?

options.text: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
Do not use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright or reflective clothing. Add extra lights to your motorcycle and use your turn signals. Flash your brake light when needed.
